reviewer: ChatGPT-Web pr_triage independent local read-only reviewer
scope: Scratch Greenhouse public capture and actual offline production collector persistence oracle for the remaining third source of literal MJ-REQ-228.
checks: Only exact GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/greenhouse and https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/greenhouse/jobs?content=true accepted, once each.
Pinned helper SHA256 enforced before import; it rejects authorization/cookie headers and bounds both wire and adapter-decoded responses.
Capture 20s, requests 6s, concurrency 1 and 1s live request-start spacing. Each endpoint owns a transport because production Greenhouse closes each request client.
Both exact wire responses are retained with exclusive files and hashes; replay rejects changed hashes/endpoints or missing responses.
Exact tenant greenhouse and source-company attribution match production adapter semantics; native requisition source IDs used without aggregator identity substitution.
Expected posting IDs and content-addressed snapshot IDs/hashes derived without changing or pre-deduplicating source input.
Company identity, name and domain checked exactly against captured board metadata, and all captured job company attributions match.
Actual collect_source runs twice in throwaway SQLite with sockets/subprocesses denied, total jobs_seen equal captured entries, rejected=0, direct_application false.
Exact durable posting/snapshot/company identities and counts, stable canonical state, HEALTHY stored source and zero application/attempt rows required across both passes and both database reopens.
One fixture timestamp update makes only the throwaway source eligible for offline second polling; it causes no additional external request.
Failure exits nonzero and leaves result FAIL. Existing WWR failures and earlier evidence are preserved; no source/canonical edit.

fixture_evidence.execution: Executed by harness_delivery; exact report and implementation independently inspected, not rerun by this reviewer.

limitations: A passing fixture run is not live acceptance. Root must execute this immutable script, then the resulting live evidence must be reviewed before MJ-REQ-228 can be proposed PASS.
A successful Greenhouse run would satisfy the generic third-source criterion alongside Remotive and RemoteOK, but does not repair or relabel WWR production failure SOURCE_DUPLICATE_JOB_ID.
